note: Every photo was visually verified against the image file before saving. One entry (perpustakaan.jpg) is flagged as not fully certain — see its note.

al-baqi.jpg.confirmation: Verified: wide sandy field of low grave mounds with the Prophet's Mosque minarets and Green Dome in the background — Jannat Al-Baqi.

area-wanita.jpg.confirmation: Verified: women seated on the red-patterned carpet inside the mosque under striped arches, behind wooden screens — the women's prayer area.

bab-as-salam.jpg.confirmation: Verified: close-up of the gate entrance with the green plaque reading 'Bab As-Salam' in gold Arabic calligraphy.
bab-as-salam.jpg.source_page: Foursquare CDN (fastly.4sqi.net) — no source page returned by image search

bab-jibril.jpg.confirmation: Verified: mosque gate whose small green side plaque reads 'Bab Jibril' (confirmed by zooming the plaque); image is from the dedicated Bab-e-Jibraeel page. Note: small IslamicLandmarks.com logo watermark in the bottom-right corner.

kubah-hijau.jpg.confirmation: Verified: the Green Dome centred in frame with the silver dome and minarets of Al-Masjid An-Nabawi under a clear blue sky.

masjid-abu-bakar.jpg.confirmation: Verified: small dark-stone mosque with a single white dome and one minaret among modern buildings — Masjid Abu Bakr As-Siddiq, west of the Prophet's Mosque.

masjid-al-ghamama.jpg.confirmation: Verified: dark-stone mosque with several small domes, arched portico and a single minaret — Masjid Al-Ghamama, west of the Prophet's Mosque.

payung-courtyard.jpg.confirmation: Verified: the mosque courtyard seen from under the giant open retractable umbrellas, with the mosque facade and crowds in the distance.

perpustakaan.jpg.confirmation: NOT FULLY CERTAIN: a library aisle with tall wooden shelves full of books, taken from the Prophet's Mosque Library listing page (Google user photo). The aisle itself is generic-looking and cannot be independently distinguished from another library — use with care.

raudhah.jpg.confirmation: Verified: interior corridor with the distinctive green patterned carpet, gold railings and gilded pillars of the Rawdah area.

saqifah.jpg.confirmation: Verified: manicured garden with palm trees, lawns and trimmed hedges — the Saqifah Bani Sa'idah garden.

zamzam.jpg.confirmation: Verified: a woman filling a bottle at a large stainless-steel Zamzam water dispenser unit in the Prophet's Mosque courtyard, under the open umbrellas.
zamzam.jpg.source_page: callforumrah.com — no source page returned by image search
